reason: The full `npm run e2e:slow` fails on locked e2e/rapid-pace.spec.ts:311 ('200 rapid hands with a folding user finish in under 60 minutes', Chromium). Q-2/Q-3 do not cover it, and the spec (section 11) says a rapid-pace failure is escalated. The cause is the test's scripted-user helper, not the line-up code. With Game Config's Mixed bots, a Calling station limps, so the user in the big blind is checked to. The bar then shows only 'Check' and 'Raise to $8' (no Fold button), and foldElseCheck's `fold.isEnabled()` waits for a Fold button that never appears, until the 65-minute test timeout. With the old all-TAG default no bot ever limped, so this never happened.
evidence: /tmp/tlh-e2e-slow.txt: 1 failed, 5 skipped, 14 passed (1.1h), exit 1. Error: `locator.isEnabled: Test timeout of 3900000ms exceeded ... waiting for getByRole('group', { name: 'Your actions' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Fold', exact: true })` at foldElseCheck (e2e/rapid-pace.spec.ts:180), called from :323. Page snapshot at the timeout (test-results/rapid-pace-200-rapid-hands-...-chromium/error-context.md): header 'Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · Hand #16', 'You · Big blind', a Calling station with 'Called $4', and 'Your actions' holding only the buttons 'Check' and 'Raise to $8'. The hands before #16 ran with no failure. All other slow tests passed (rapid-pace pace checks and responsive-table, Chromium and WebKit). The 200-hand test is Chromium-only. The helper (e2e/rapid-pace.spec.ts:177-181, owner TASK-3.13/TASK-3.27) is not unlocked. No locked test was edited for this.
options: A (recommended): unlock e2e/rapid-pace.spec.ts (TASK-3.13 / TASK-3.27) for a routine helper fix that changes no assertion: foldElseCheck clicks Fold only when a Fold button exists and is enabled (e.g. `(await fold.count()) > 0 && (await fold.isEnabled())`), else Check. This matches its own doc comment ('Fold when it is enabled, otherwise Check'). Then rerun the full `npm run e2e:slow` (about 1 hour).

B: make the action bar always show a Fold button (disabled when the user can check). This changes product behaviour and TASK-3.2's locked bar labels (e.g. action-bar.spec.ts expects ['Check', 'Bet $4']). Not recommended.

C: change the default line-up away from Mixed for this test only (e.g. pick Tough on Game Config in openNewGame). This still edits the locked file and no longer tests the default table. Not recommended.
